description: Sync v0.6.15–v0.6.17; dsh native sub-agents; YAML flow lists; task.py workflow NameError
changelog:
**Enhancements:**
- Synced from main: v0.6.15 (DeepSeek Harness `trellis init --dsh`), v0.6.16 (context-manifest gate, task lifecycle, ablation, OpenCode mem, hook/channel fixes), v0.6.17 (Devin CLI `--platform devin`, lazy SQLite pages, Pi headless ask, active-task isolation, archive unlink restore).
- On beta, `trellis init --dsh` installs native research/implement/check sub-agents (`trellis-agent-{research,implement,check}`). Stable 0.6.15 still runs those phases inline. (#548)

**Bug Fixes:**
- `parse_simple_yaml` accepts scalar flow sequences such as `spec_injection.tools: []`.
- `task.py workflow` imports `read_json` from `common.io` (no `NameError` when pinning a workflow).
notes: Run `npm install -g @mindfoldhq/trellis@beta` then `trellis update`. No `--migrate` required.
